judged_text: APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is typed as `string | undefined` (the && of two env strings), not a boolean, so every `if (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && ...)` and the webhook's `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED)` rely on implicit truthiness of a non-empty string. If either env var is set to a whitespace or placeholder value (e.g. copied from .env.example as `""` is left but a space is pasted in), the flag silently flips on and all token refreshes route to the (broken) sync path; a boolean coercion or explicit check would fail fast instead.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/lib/constants.ts`, `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, which at runtime yields the second env var string (or `undefined`), not a boolean. The diff shows it being used as a boolean gate (e.g. `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED)` in `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` and `if (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT ...)` in the new OAuth helpers). This relies on implicit truthiness of non-empty strings, so mis-set values like whitespace would incorrectly enable the feature and route behavior down the “sharing/sync” paths with invalid secrets/keys instead of failing fast.
